attchmntText: We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today, i.e. onOctober 26, 2026, has inter-alia, considered and approved Unaudited Standalone and ConsolidatedFinancial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, asrecommended by the Audit Committee.Pursuant to Regulations 30 and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements)Regulations, 2015 ("Listing Regulations"), we are enclosing herewith the following documents:1. Limited Review Reports issued by M/s. Price Waterhouse Chartered Accountants LLP,Statutory Auditors of the Company on Unaudited Standalone & Consolidated FinancialResults for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026;2. Unaudited Standalone & Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter andhalf year ended September 30, 2026, Segment-Wise Revenue, Results, Assets and Liabilitiesfor the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 along with Statement of Assets andLiabilities as at September 30, 2026 and Statement of Cash Flows for the half year endedSeptember 30, 2026.

Pursuant to the Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations ) read with SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, we would like to inform the exchanges that the Nomination and Remuneration Committee at its meeting held on October 22, 2026 has granted 95,000 stock options under Company s Employees Stock Option Scheme - 2021 (ESOS -2021) to the identified employees of the Company at an exercise price of Rs. 460/- per option. The details as required under Listing Regulations read with SEBI Master Circular is enclosed herewith as an  Annexure-I .

In furtherance to our earlier intimation dated March 27, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations ), we would like to inform the exchanges that pursuant to the first and final call notice issued by Everest Buildpro Private Limited ( EBPL ), the Company has paid the first and final call amount of Rs. 1,12,93,02,900/- to EBPL and accordingly, 1,54,150 partly paid-up equity shares of Rs. 10/- each of EBPL held by the Company stands converted into fully paid-up equity shares on October 15, 2026.Prior to and after the aforesaid subscription, the Company shall continue to hold 100% of the equity share capital of EBPL, and accordingly, there shall be no change in the shareholding pattern of the subsidiary. Hence, this disclosure is not mandatorily required.
